work.text: He also created landscapes and scenes of people at work and play, using a new optimistic style—broad, loose brushstrokes of vibrant color with frequent use of white space and rare use of black—with only occasional references to his morbid themes.
Here the morbid theme returns in that loose, bright late manner: Munch sits wrapped in a blanket in a wicker chair beside an unmade bed, his face sallow and his mouth hanging open.

moment.text: The 1918–1920 flu pandemic, also known as the Great Influenza epidemic or by the misleading name Spanish flu, was an exceptionally deadly global influenza pandemic caused by the H1N1 subtype of the influenza A virus.
The Expressionists were influenced by artists and sources including Edvard Munch, Vincent van Gogh and African art.

matters.text: My afflictions belong to me and my art - they have become one with me. Without illness and anxiety, I would have been a rudderless ship.

source.author: Edvard Munch

matters.text: Given his poor health history, during 1918 Munch felt himself lucky to have survived a bout of the Spanish flu, the worldwide pandemic of that year.
